patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Kaspr's shape. Choose Kaspr only if your buying job matches “LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo ann” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans sales-engagement; Kaspr leans prospecting, data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Kaspr share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; Kaspr is LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from $49/mo annual headline..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs Kaspr (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning sales-engagement vs Kaspr-leaning prospecting, data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Kaspr — LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; Kaspr: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies; Native email outreach/sequencing depth is limited versus engagement platforms.

Poor-fit cases: Gong is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases · Kaspr is a poor fit when that limitation bites: LinkedIn-centric capture — coverage and compliance depend on LinkedIn workflow policies · Avoid Gong if you actually need Kaspr's motion (LinkedIn-centric EU/EMEA B2B contact capture (Chrome) — Free plan; Starter from )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
